summary: Backend-only testing of the sendToKitchen activation bug fix. Verified that transitioning sendToKitchen false->true forces itemStatus='pending' and recalculates order.status via calculate_order_status. All 9 new tests pass plus 9 regression tests from previous iterations (kitchen_bug_fix + order_status_recalc). 18/18 backend tests green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: fix is minimal and correct: kitchen_activated flag guards both itemStatus reset and status recalculation only on the false->true transition. Deactivation & repeated activation don't touch status (verified by tests test_deactivation_does_not_touch_itemStatus and test_repeated_activation_is_idempotent).
server.py is now 1799 lines - approaching size where a split into routers (orders_router.py, menu_router.py, kitchen_router.py) is warranted for maintainability.

PATCH /orders/{id}/items/by-index/{i}: consider also touching order.status when itemStatus is directly modified via PUT .../status endpoint to keep aggregate in sync (already handled elsewhere, but worth auditing).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ResetCat_MAIN category, TEST_ResetDish_MAIN dish, adds it to today's menu, and creates one order per test (all cleaned up in module teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end: 1) activation from ready/problem resets itemStatus to pending AND recalculates order.status; 2) deactivation (true->false) does not touch itemStatus/order.status; 3) repeated activation is idempotent (no transition -> no reset); 4) combined PATCH (sendToKitchen+quantity+notes) applies all + resets; 5) GET /api/kitchen reflects the reset. All test IDs are ephemeral, no need to prep seed data. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_kitchen_reset_pending_fix.py. Set env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before pytest.
rca of the issue: Original bug: user clicks kitchen icon to flag item for cucina; entry appeared as 'already prepared' in Reports > Cucina because item.itemStatus was still 'ready' from a prior misclick/state carry-over. Fix (server.py L865-875, L907-911): detect false->true transition via `kitchen_activated` boolean; if true, force item.itemStatus='pending' and set order.status via calculate_order_status(items). Reproduction pre-fix: PUT status ready, then PATCH sendToKitchen=true -> item was still ready. Post-fix (verified): item goes back to pending and order status recalculated to in_attesa.
